verdict.rc: Deploy v412 raised the app pool ceiling above Postgres’ connection limit, so the database started refusing connections.
verdict.why: v412 set db.pool.max_size 20→60, but Postgres max_connections is 50. The 51st connection was refused, so workers blocked acquiring — pool_wait hit 1.82s and p95 followed ~90s after the rollout.
verdict.dx: redis cache ruled out — hit-rate steady 0.9987  ·  traffic surge ruled out — rps flat 4,182

decision.voice: “High blast radius in prod. I won’t touch it until you approve.”
decision.diff:
payment-service · rollback plan · dry-run passed
− v412 db.pool.max_size: 60 # > max_connections (50)
+ v411 db.pool.max_size: 20 # last known-good, 3h uptime
decision.impact: what it touches6 / 6 pods · prod · re-point, no rebuildin the blast path100% of card authorizations · ~4,182 rpsreversibleyes — one-click undo

resolved.tx: Verified resolved. Re-queried the incident’s own metric after rollback — p95 back to 0.33s, db_conns 18/50. No rollback of the rollback needed · MTTR 142s.
